description: This file contains functional tests for the AccountController's sign-in functionality in an ASP.NET Core web application. It uses xUnit for testing and interacts with the web application's login, profile update, and verification token features.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A test class for verifying the sign-in and account management functionalities of the AccountController.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the login endpoint returns the login screen containing a specific email.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Checks that the regex correctly matches and extracts the verification token from an input HTML string.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Verifies that the login page contains a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates posting valid credentials and expects a redirect to the root URL indicating successful login.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Logs in, then updates the user's phone number and verifies the update reflected in the profile page.
